sentences.en: In 2011, the body of a woman was discovered in a California vineyard.
sentences.zh: 2011年，在加利福尼亚州的一个葡萄园里发现了一具女性尸体。

sentences.en: She had been decapitated, and her body had been drained of blood.
sentences.zh: 她被斩首，体内的血液也被抽干。

sentences.en: It appeared her killer had gone to extraordinary lengths to conceal her identity.
sentences.zh: 看来她的凶手费尽心机来隐瞒她的身份。

sentences.en: For more than a decade, she was known only as Jane Doe.
sentences.zh: 十多年来，人们只知道她叫简·多伊。

sentences.en: Then, detectives finally learned her name, Ada.
sentences.zh: 然后，侦探们终于知道了她的名字，艾达。

sentences.en: But, identifying her only made this bizarre murder even more perplexing.
sentences.zh: 但是，确定她的身份只会让这起离奇的谋杀案更加扑朔迷离。

sentences.en: Ada is the new series from Casefile Presents, available now wherever you get your podcasts.
sentences.zh: 《艾达》是“罪案档案呈现”推出的全新系列，各大播客平台现已上线。

sentences.en: Warnings, please see the show notes for this episode on your app or on our website.
sentences.zh: 关于警告事项，请查看您使用的应用程序上或我们网站上的本集节目说明。

sentences.en: Today's episode involves crimes against children, and won't be suitable for all listeners.
sentences.zh: 今天的节目涉及针对儿童的犯罪，并不适合所有听众收听。

sentences.en: 30-year-old Leanna Harris was nearing the end of her workday on Wednesday, June 18, 2014, when at 3.16pm she received a text message.
sentences.zh: 2014年6月18日星期三下午3点16分，30岁的莉安娜·哈里斯接近下班时，收到了一条短信。

sentences.en: It was from her husband, 33-year-old Justin Harris, who went by his middle name of Ross.
sentences.zh: 发件人是她的丈夫、33岁的贾斯汀·哈里斯，他通常使用自己的中间名罗斯。

sentences.en: When are you getting my buddy?
sentences.zh: 你什么时候来接我的小伙子？

sentences.en: The message read.
sentences.zh: 短信上写道。

sentences.en: Ross was referring to the couple's son, 22-month-old Cooper Harris, who needed to be picked up from daycare.
sentences.zh: 罗斯指的是这对夫妇22个月大的儿子库珀·哈里斯，他需要去日托中心接回来。

sentences.en: The couple typically took turns dropping Cooper off and picking him up, depending on whose schedule worked best at the time.
sentences.zh: 这对夫妇通常轮流送库珀去日托和接他回家，具体取决于当时谁的工作日程更合适。

sentences.en: Ross had dropped him off that morning as Leanna had an early start in her job as a dietician.
sentences.zh: 罗斯那天早上送他去的，因为莉安娜作为一名营养师需要早起上班。

sentences.en: It was agreed that Leanna would pick Cooper up because Ross had plans to go to the movies with friends after work to see the comedy action film, 22 Jump Street.
sentences.zh: 双方商定由莉安娜去接库珀，因为罗斯计划下班后和朋友去看电影，观看动作喜剧片《龙虎少年队2》。

sentences.en: Leanna clocked off at 4pm and made the one-hour drive to the Little Apron Academy in Vinnings, Georgia.
sentences.zh: 莉安娜在下午4点打卡下班，开车一个小时来到了佐治亚州维宁斯的“小围裙学院”。

sentences.en: The childcare facility was custom-built for employees at the Home Depot's Atlanta headquarters, where Ross Harris worked as a web developer.
sentences.zh: 这家托儿所是专为家得宝亚特兰大总部员工建造的，罗斯·哈里斯就在那里担任网页开发人员。

sentences.en: It was conveniently located just 5.5 miles from the Harris' home in the city of Marietta and right around the corner from Ross' work.
sentences.zh: 它地理位置优越，距离哈里斯夫妇位于玛丽埃塔市的家仅5.5英里，而且就在罗斯单位的转角处。

sentences.en: Cooper had been a regular attendee at the Little Apron Academy since he was about 6 weeks old, where the staff had come to know the Harris family well.
sentences.zh: 库珀大约6周大时就开始定期去“小围裙学院”，那里的工作人员对哈里斯一家非常熟悉。

sentences.en: Leanna had done the daycare run countless times, but when she entered the building on this occasion, Cooper's teacher looked surprised to see her.
sentences.zh: 莉安娜已经无数次接送过孩子了，但这次当她走进大楼时，库珀的老师看到她显得很惊讶。

sentences.en: "'What are you doing here?'' the teacher asked.
sentences.zh: “你来这里干什么？”老师问道。

sentences.en: Leanna was confused.
sentences.zh: 莉安娜感到很困惑。

sentences.en: "'I'm here to get Cooper,' she responded.
sentences.zh: “我是来接库珀的，”她回答说。

sentences.en: The teacher looked at her with a puzzled expression on her face and said,
sentences.zh: 老师一脸困惑地看着她说道：

sentences.en: "'Cooper's not here.'"
sentences.zh: “库珀不在托儿所。”

sentences.en: It took Leanna a moment to register what she was hearing.
sentences.zh: 莉安娜花了一会儿才反应过来自己听到了什么。

sentences.en: Assuming it was some kind of twisted joke, she asked,
sentences.zh: 她以为这是一个恶劣的玩笑，便问：

sentences.en: "'No, really, where is Cooper?'
sentences.zh: “不是吧，说真的，库珀在哪里？”

sentences.en: But the teacher looked her square in the eye and firmly repeated,
sentences.zh: 但老师直视着她的眼睛，坚定地重复道：

sentences.en: "'He's not here.'"
sentences.zh: “他不在。”

sentences.en: Leanna didn't know what to think.
sentences.zh: 莉安娜不知道该想什么。

sentences.en: She was immediately overcome with fear as all kinds of scenarios flooded through her mind.
sentences.zh: 她顿时被恐惧淹没，各种场景涌入她的脑海。

sentences.en: What if someone had kidnapped Cooper?
sentences.zh: 如果有人绑架了库珀怎么办？

sentences.en: What if Ross had absentmindedly left him at home that morning by mistake?
sentences.zh: 如果罗斯那天早上粗心大意地把他忘在家裡怎么办？

sentences.en: A daycare employee offered to drive with Leanna to Ross' office building around the corner.
sentences.zh: 托儿所的一名员工主动提出开车陪莉安娜去转角的罗斯办公室大楼。

sentences.en: When they got to the Home Depot parking lot, Leanna couldn't see Ross' car anywhere.
sentences.zh: 当他们到达家得宝停车场时，莉安娜到处都看不到罗斯的车。

sentences.en: Panicked, Leanna raced into the office building, desperately trying to call Ross as she ran.
sentences.zh: 莉安娜惊慌失措地冲进办公大楼，一边跑一边拼命给罗斯打电话。

sentences.en: He didn't answer his phone, and the security guard in the lobby told her that Ross had already left work for the day.
sentences.zh: 他没有接电话，大厅的保安告诉她罗斯已经下班离开了。

sentences.en: Leanna sat in the lobby as she contemplated what to do next.
sentences.zh: 莉安娜坐在大厅里，思考着接下来该怎么办。

sentences.en: Then, her phone rang.
sentences.zh: 这时，她的电话响了。

sentences.en: It was a detective.
sentences.zh: 是一个侦探打来的。

sentences.en: He asked Leanna where she was and told her to stay put, saying he was coming to see her.
sentences.zh: 他问莉安娜在哪里，并让她原地别动，说他正要去找她。

sentences.en: "'It's bad, right?' Leanna asked him.
sentences.zh: “情况很糟糕，对吧？”莉安娜问他。

sentences.en: "'Yes,' the detective replied.
sentences.zh: “是的，”侦探回答。

sentences.en: "'It's bad.'"
sentences.zh: “很糟糕。”

sentences.en: Approximately half an hour earlier, at 4.24pm, police officers had pulled into the parking lot at the Acres Mill Square Shopping Centre,
sentences.zh: 大约半小时前，即下午4点24分，警察将车开进了橡树磨坊广场购物中心的停车场，

sentences.en: roughly two miles from the Home Depot headquarters, to find a troubling scene.
sentences.zh: 该地点距离家得宝总部大约两英里，映入眼帘的是令人不安的一幕。

sentences.en: A silver Hyundai Tucson SUV was parked haphazardly on the curb, with the crowd gathered around looking at something on the pavement.
sentences.zh: 一辆银色现代途胜SUV杂乱地停在路边，人群围拢过来看着路面上的某个东西。

sentences.en: It was the body of 22-month-old Cooper Harris, his skin a bluish-green and his veins clearly visible under his pale skin.
sentences.zh: 那是22个月大的库珀·哈里斯的尸体，他的皮肤呈青绿色，苍白的皮肤下静脉清晰可见。

sentences.en: His father, Ross Harris, was pacing nervously nearby, his cell phone pressed to his ear, as a good Samaritan unsuccessfully attempted CPR on the small boy.
sentences.zh: 他的父亲罗斯·哈里斯在一旁焦急地踱步，手机紧贴着耳朵，一位热心市民正试图对这个小男孩进行心肺复苏，但没有成功。

sentences.en: "'What have I done?' Ross screamed.
sentences.zh: “我做了什么？”罗斯尖叫道。

sentences.en: "'What have I done?' I killed my son."
sentences.zh: “我做了什么？我害死了我的儿子。”

sentences.en: One of the officers stepped in and took over the resuscitation attempt, but it was clear that Cooper had been deceased for some time.
sentences.zh: 其中一名警官上前接手了心肺复苏，但很明显库珀已经去世一段时间了。

sentences.en: Ross came closer, shrieking hysterically.
sentences.zh: 罗斯走近了些，歇斯底里地尖叫着。

sentences.en: "'Oh my God!
sentences.zh: “哦，我的上帝！

sentences.en: Oh my God!'
sentences.zh: 哦，我的上帝！”

sentences.en: One of the officers asked Ross to get off the phone and show them some ID.
sentences.zh: 其中一名警官要求罗斯挂断电话并出示一些身份证明。

sentences.en: He told them to hold on.
sentences.zh: 他叫他们稍等。

sentences.en: When they asked him again, he snapped,
sentences.zh: 当他们再次要求他时，他厉声说道：

sentences.en: "'Shut the fuck up and hold on.
sentences.zh: “给老子闭嘴，等一下。

sentences.en: My son just died.'"
sentences.zh: 我儿子刚死。”

sentences.en: This reaction prompted the police to place Ross in handcuffs and put him into the back of a patrol car to ensure he didn't flee the scene.
sentences.zh: 这一反应促使警方给罗斯戴上手铐，并把他塞进巡逻车后座，以确保他不会逃离现场。

sentences.en: He promised to calm down if they just removed the cuffs, saying,
sentences.zh: 他承诺只要他们解下手铐就会平静下来，说道：

sentences.en: "'You have to understand, I'm just really upset.
sentences.zh: “你们得明白，我只是真的很心烦。”

sentences.en: "'Ross told the police he needed to call the Little Apron Academy before his wife arrived to find Cooper wasn't there.
sentences.zh: 罗斯告诉警察，他需要在妻子到达发现库珀不在那裡之前给“小围裙学院”打电话。

sentences.en: One of the officers asked why she would think her son was there.
sentences.zh: 其中一名警官问为什么她会认为她的儿子在那裡。

sentences.en: Ross responded,
sentences.zh: 罗斯回答说：

sentences.en: "'Because I was supposed to drop him off this morning and I didn't do a second look in my car and left him in my car while I was at work.
sentences.zh: “因为我本该在今天早上送他去，而我没有回头仔细检查我的车，在我上班时把他留在了车里。

sentences.en: I swore I swore I dropped him off.
sentences.zh: 我发誓我发誓我把他送到了。

sentences.en: I thought I did.'"
sentences.zh: 我以为我送了。”

sentences.en: Ross Harris was taken to the police station where he explained to two interviewing detectives that the morning had started out like any other.
sentences.zh: 罗斯·哈里斯被带到警察局，他向两名进行讯问的侦探解释说，这个早晨和往常一样开始。

sentences.en: Cooper had been having trouble sleeping over the past few nights and had woken up early at around 5.15am.
sentences.zh: 库珀过去几个晚上一直睡眠不好，早上5点15分左右就醒了。

sentences.en: Ross got up and brought him into bed with him and Leanna where they all snoozed until Leanna left for work at around 7.15.
sentences.zh: 罗斯起床把他抱进他和莉安娜的床上，三人一直小睡到莉安娜7点15左右出门上班。

sentences.en: Ross and Cooper then got up and watched cartoons until it was time to leave for the day.
sentences.zh: 随后罗斯和库珀起床看动画片，直到该出门上班的时候。

sentences.en: Ross typically dropped Cooper at daycare in time for breakfast, but they were running late,
sentences.zh: 罗斯通常会及时把库珀送到日托中心吃早餐，但他们快迟到了，

sentences.en: so he decided they'd have a daddy-son meal at the Chick-fil-A restaurant near his work instead.
sentences.zh: 所以他决定他们去他公司附近的福来鸡餐厅吃一顿父子大餐。

sentences.en: Ross ordered breakfast from there most days, usually from the drive-thru, but every couple of weeks he brought Cooper along with him and they dined in.
sentences.zh: 罗斯大部分日子都在那里点早餐，通常是通过免下车窗口，但每隔几周他就会带着库珀一起去堂食。

sentences.en: Ross said that after eating breakfast, he strapped Cooper into his car seat and kissed him like he always did.
sentences.zh: 罗斯说吃完早餐后，他把库珀系在安全座椅上，像往常一样吻了他。

sentences.en: He then pulled onto Cumberland Parkway and headed towards the Little Apron Academy, but instead of turning left at the upcoming intersection like he was supposed to,
sentences.zh: 然后他驶上坎伯兰大道，朝“小围裙学院”开去，但没有像应该的那样在前面的路口左转，

sentences.en: he must have continued straight towards his office.
sentences.zh: 他一定是一直笔直开向他的办公室。

sentences.en: Ross said that Cooper didn't make a sound so he must have fallen asleep and Ross had completely forgotten he was there.
sentences.zh: 罗斯说库珀没有发出一点声音，所以他一定睡着了，而罗斯完全忘记了他在那裡。

sentences.en: He parked in Home Depot's surface parking lot and proceeded to work a normal 7-hour shift, going out for lunch with some friends before knocking off to go to the movies.
sentences.zh: 他把车停在家得宝的地面停车场，开始了他正常的7小时工作班次，和几个朋友出去吃午饭，然后下班去看电影。

sentences.en: Ross admonished himself for not checking the back seat before he went into work that morning.
sentences.zh: 罗斯责备自己那天早上上班前没有检查后座。

sentences.en: He told the detectives that he knew how dangerous a hot car could be for a small child ever since he'd seen a news report about a man who accidentally did the same thing.
sentences.zh: 他告诉侦探们，自从他看到一则关于一个男人不小心做了同样事情的新闻报道后，他就知道炎热的车内对一个小孩子来说有多么危险。

sentences.en: That man had since become an advocate for parents to always turn around and double-check the back seat.
sentences.zh: 那个男人后来成为了一名倡导者，呼吁父母们时刻回头仔细检查后座。

sentences.en: Ross explained,
sentences.zh: 罗斯解释道：

sentences.en: I've been doing that because the worst fear for me is to leave my son in a hot car.
sentences.zh: 我一直在这样做，因为我最害怕的就是把儿子忘在热烘烘的车里。

sentences.en: He said he'd also watched an online video about the dangers of leaving dogs inside hot cars and it had made him think about how terrible it would be for a child.
sentences.zh: 他说他还看过一个关于把狗留在热车里的危险的网络视频，这让他想到了这对一个孩子来说会是多么可怕。

sentences.en: When asked about his relationship with Liana, Ross said it was good, with its typical ups and downs.
sentences.zh: 当被问及与莉安娜的关系时，罗斯说很好，有着典型的起起落落。

sentences.en: He said their finances were solid, other than some student debt from their college days.
sentences.zh: 他说他们的财务状况很稳健，除了大学时代的一些学生贷款。

sentences.en: The detectives told Ross that Liana had been notified about what happened and was at the station.
sentences.zh: 侦探告诉罗斯，莉安娜已经被通知发生了什么事，并且已经在警局了。

sentences.en: They needed to go speak with her and in the meantime, they told Ross he'd be held in a cell.
sentences.zh: 他们需要去和她谈谈，在此期间，他们告诉罗斯他将被关在牢房里。

sentences.en: Ross asked why.
sentences.zh: 罗斯问为什么。

sentences.en: The detectives explained that because his actions led to Cooper's death, he was going to be charged, most likely with cruelty to a child.
sentences.zh: 侦探解释说，因为他的行为导致了库珀的死亡，他将被指控，最可能是虐待儿童罪。

sentences.en: Ross seemed shocked.
sentences.zh: 罗斯显得很震惊。

sentences.en: It was completely unintentional, he stated.
sentences.zh: 他声称这完全是无意的。

sentences.en: I have no history of child abuse, no history of domestic violence.
sentences.zh: 我没有虐待儿童的历史，没有家庭暴力历史。

sentences.en: I have no criminal history.
sentences.zh: 我没有任何犯罪历史。

sentences.en: I have no record whatsoever.
sentences.zh: 我没有任何案底。

sentences.en: I've worked in a law enforcement environment.
sentences.zh: 我在执法环境中工作过。

sentences.en: I'm a great father and I have multiple people who would back that up.
sentences.zh: 我是一个好父亲，我有很多人可以为此背书。

sentences.en: Ross wasn't exaggerating.
sentences.zh: 罗斯并没有夸大其词。

sentences.en: The 33-year-old had a clean background.
sentences.zh: 这位33岁的男子有着干净的背景。

sentences.en: He'd been raised in the Alabama city of Tuscaloosa, where he'd held various jobs at the University of Alabama before working as a police dispatcher for several years.
sentences.zh: 他在阿拉巴马州城市塔斯卡卢萨长大，曾在阿拉巴马大学担任过各种工作，之后担任了几年警察调度员。

sentences.en: He'd met Liana when he was 23 and the two quickly fell in love and got married.
sentences.zh: 他在23岁时遇到了莉安娜，两人迅速坠入爱河并结了婚。

sentences.en: Liana was introverted and earnest, whereas Ross was extroverted and outgoing.
sentences.zh: 莉安娜内向而真诚，而罗斯则外向而开朗。

sentences.en: Together, they brought out the best of each other's personalities.
sentences.zh: 他们在一起激发了彼此性格中最美好的一面。

sentences.en: Ross helped to bring Liana out of her shell, while Liana motivated Ross to reach his potential and encouraged him to go back to school.
sentences.zh: 罗斯帮助莉安娜走出了内心的壳，而莉安娜则激励罗斯发挥出自己的潜力并鼓励他重返校园。

sentences.en: He went on to get a bachelor's degree in commerce and business administration, which led to his job at Home Depot.
sentences.zh: 他后来获得了商业与企业管理学士学位，这为他在家得宝找到了工作。

sentences.en: The couple relocated to Atlanta in 2012, where Ross lived an active social life and played guitar in their church band.
sentences.zh: 这对夫妇于2012年搬到了亚特兰大，罗斯在那里过着活跃的社交生活，并在他们教堂的乐队里弹吉他。

sentences.en: Life was going well for the couple, but there was just one thing missing.
sentences.zh: 这对夫妇的生活过得很好，但唯独少了一样东西。

sentences.en: From a very young age, the one thing Liana wanted was to be a wife and mother.
sentences.zh: 从小到大，莉安娜最想要的就是成为一名妻子和母亲。

sentences.en: Likewise, Ross wanted children so badly that his work colleagues even referred to him as soccer dad.
sentences.zh: 同样，罗斯非常渴望孩子，以至于他的同事甚至称他为足球老爸。

sentences.en: After months of trying, in early 2012, the couple got the good news they'd been desperately hoping for.
sentences.zh: 经过几个月的努力，在2012年初，这对夫妇得到了他们一直热切期盼的好消息。

sentences.en: Liana was pregnant.
sentences.zh: 莉安娜怀孕了。

sentences.en: Ross was so excited that he uploaded a video of their first ultrasound to his YouTube account, along with the caption,
sentences.zh: 罗斯兴奋地将他们第一次B超检查的视频上传到他的YouTube账户，并配上了说明文字，

sentences.en: First video known as Cooper.
sentences.zh: 第一个视频，名为库珀。

sentences.en: When Cooper was born on Sunday August 12, 2012, holding him for the first time was the best feeling in the world for Liana.
sentences.zh: 2012年8月12日星期日，当库珀出生时，第一次抱起他是莉安娜在世界上感觉最美妙的时刻。

sentences.en: As the couple navigated their way through the first few exhausting months of parenting a fussy baby,
sentences.zh: 随着这对夫妇度过了抚养一个挑剔婴儿最初几个精疲力竭的月份，

sentences.en: Liana was impressed with how well Ross stepped into his new role.
sentences.zh: 莉安娜对罗斯很好地胜任新角色印象深刻。

sentences.en: He was a dedicated, hands-on father who never hesitated to get up in the night to put Cooper back to sleep.
sentences.zh: 他是一个专注、身体力行的父亲，毫不犹豫地在夜里起床哄库珀重新入睡。

sentences.en: The father and son developed a special bond, with the young boy's blue eyes lighting up every time Ross walked into the room.
sentences.zh: 这对父子培养了一种特殊的纽带，每次罗斯走进房间，小男孩蓝色的眼睛就会发亮。

sentences.en: Cooper grew to be a happy, smiley and thriving baby.
sentences.zh: 库珀长成了一个快乐、爱笑且茁壮成长的婴儿。

sentences.en: By the time his second birthday was approaching, he'd developed an adventurous personality and a love for cars of all kinds.
sentences.zh: 随着他两岁生日的临近，他展现出了富有冒险精神的性格，并且对各种汽车都充满了热爱。

sentences.en: Everyone who knew Ross Harris described him as a nice, well-mannered man who was a great husband, supportive friend and devoted father.
sentences.zh: 认识罗斯·哈里斯的每个人都形容他是一个人很好、很有礼貌的男人，是个好丈夫、支持他的朋友和慈爱的父亲。

sentences.en: He gushed about Cooper so much that one colleague even told him that people were sick of hearing about the baby.
sentences.zh: 他对库珀赞不绝口，以至于一位同事甚至告诉他，大家对这个孩子的话题都已经听腻了。

sentences.en: Therefore, as the news spread about Cooper's death, there could only be one explanation for those who knew the Harris family.
sentences.zh: 因此，随着库珀死讯的传开，认识哈里斯一家的所有人只能有一个解释。

sentences.en: This was a tragic accident that couldn't have happened to less deserving people.
sentences.zh: 这是一场悲惨的事故，本不该发生在一个最不该遭遇此事的家庭身上。

sentences.en: And it wouldn't be the first time.
sentences.zh: 而且这并不是第一次发生。

sentences.en: According to the not-for-profit organisation Kids and Car Safety, an average of around 40 young children die in the US each year after being left in a hot car.
sentences.zh: 根据非营利组织“儿童与汽车安全”的数据，美国每年平均有约40名幼儿在被遗忘在热车内后死亡。

sentences.en: While some of those deaths occur due to criminal negligence or after a caregiver,
sentences.zh: 虽然其中一些死亡是由于刑事疏忽造成的，或者是因为看护者

sentences.en: uneducated on the dangers, decides to leave a child in the car while they work or attend an appointment, a majority of caregivers simply forget that their child is in the car.
sentences.zh: 对危险缺乏了解，决定在工作或参加预约时将孩子留在车内，但大多数看护者只是忘记了他们的孩子在车里。

sentences.en: It is such a common phenomenon that it has its own name,
sentences.zh: 这是一个如此普遍的现象，以至于它拥有自己的名字，

sentences.en: Forgotten Baby Syndrome.
sentences.zh: 被遗忘的婴儿综合征。

sentences.en: As Associate Professor of Law Erika Breitfeld explained in her article about the phenomenon for the Berkeley Journal of Criminal Law,
sentences.zh: 正如法学副教授埃里卡·布雷特费尔德在她为《伯克利刑事法杂志》撰写的关于这种现象的文章中所解释的那样，

sentences.en: part of the reason parents can forget their children in the car is because of where the children are placed in a vehicle.
sentences.zh: 父母之所以会把孩子忘在车里，部分原因在于孩子在车内的放置位置。

sentences.en: Children, especially those under the age of three, are almost always in a rear-facing car seat.
sentences.zh: 儿童，尤其是三岁以下的儿童，几乎总是坐在朝后的汽车座椅上。

sentences.en: Consequently, when a parent looks behind them in the back seat, whether or not the child is in the car, they see the same thing, the back of the child's car seat, not the child.
sentences.zh: 因此，当父母向车后座看去时，无论车里有没有孩子，他们看到的都是一样的东西——儿童安全座椅的背面，而不是孩子。

sentences.en: Because many young children fall asleep during car rides, there are often no audio cues to remind a caregiver of their presence in the vehicle.
sentences.zh: 因为许多幼儿在乘车时会睡着，所以经常没有声音提示来提醒看护者他们在车内。

sentences.en: Parents, who are often sleep-deprived in those early years, have nothing to remind them that a child is in the back seat except their own memory.
sentences.zh: 在最初的几年里，父母往往睡眠不足，除了他们自己的记忆之外，没有什么能提醒他们后座上还有一个孩子。

sentences.en: On a warm day, the internal temperature of a vehicle rises rapidly, even when the windows are partially open.
sentences.zh: 在温暖的日子里，即使车窗半开，车内的温度也会迅速上升。

sentences.en: A child's body heat also rises up to five times faster than an adult.
sentences.zh: 儿童的体温上升速度也比成年人快多达五倍。

sentences.en: If a child is left in a hot car, it doesn't take long before they become hypothermic and their organs begin to shut down.
sentences.zh: 如果把孩子留在热车里，用不了多久他们就会体温过低，器官开始衰竭。

sentences.en: On the day Cooper Harris died, the external temperature had reached 86 degrees Fahrenheit, or 30 degrees Celsius, by midday.
sentences.zh: 在库珀·哈里斯去世的那天，到中午时分，外部温度已达到华氏86度，即摄氏30度。

sentences.en: It was estimated that the inside of Ross's vehicle could have reached around 100 degrees Fahrenheit, or 38 degrees Celsius, by 1pm, and that Cooper was likely dead by then.
sentences.zh: 据估计，到下午1点，罗斯的车内温度可能已达到华氏100度（约合摄氏38度），而库珀当时可能已经死亡。

sentences.en: Scratches on the young boy's face, as well as small abrasions on his head, hands, and feet, indicated he had struggled as he became increasingly uncomfortable.
sentences.zh: 小男孩脸上的抓痕，以及头部、手部和脚部的小擦伤，表明他在感到越来越不适时曾进行过挣扎。

sentences.en: The medical examiner said he likely experienced nausea, headache, anxiety, and possible seizures before succumbing to heat stroke.
sentences.zh: 法医表示，他在因中暑倒下之前，可能经历过恶心、头痛、焦虑和可能的癫痫发作。

sentences.en: It is a common misconception that only a negligent parent could accidentally leave their child in a hot car.
sentences.zh: 人们普遍存在一种误解，认为只有疏忽大意的父母才会不小心把孩子留在热车里。

sentences.en: The unfortunate reality is that it could happen to anyone.
sentences.zh: 不幸的现实是，这种事可能发生在任何人身上。

sentences.en: Neurologists who have studied Forgotten Baby Syndrome have found that these incidents typically occur when the brain's prospective memory system,
sentences.zh: 研究过“遗忘婴儿综合征”的神经学家发现，这类事件通常发生在当大脑的前瞻性记忆系统——

sentences.en: which is responsible for reminding us to do things, goes into conflict with the brain's habit memory system, which is the part of our brain that runs on autopilot.
sentences.zh: 也就是负责提醒我们去做事的系统，与大脑的习惯记忆系统发生冲突时，后者正是我们大脑中靠自动驾驶运行的部分。

sentences.en: When tensions arise between these two systems, often due to stress, fatigue, external events, or a change in routine, the habit memory can take over.
sentences.zh: 当这两个系统之间出现紧张状态时，通常是由压力、疲劳、突发事件或日常生活的改变引起的，习惯记忆就会接管一切。

sentences.en: If a parent's usual routine is to drive to work alone and there are no cues to remind them that the child is in the car,
sentences.zh: 如果父母日常的习惯是独自开车上班，而且没有任何线索提醒他们孩子还在车里，

sentences.en: they might drive to work on autopilot without ever dropping the child where they are supposed to go.
sentences.zh: 他们就可能会在“自动驾驶”状态下开车上班，而根本没有把孩子送到本该去的地方。

sentences.en: The brain is then capable of creating a false memory, leading the parent to believe that they dropped their child off safely.
sentences.zh: 此时大脑就有能力创造一段虚假的记忆，让父母深信自己已经安全地把孩子送到了目的地。

sentences.en: Journalist Jean Weingarten wrote about the phenomenon in a Pulitzer Prize-winning article for the Washington Post titled
sentences.zh: 记者简·温加滕曾在《华盛顿邮报》上发表过一篇获得普利策奖的文章，探讨了这一现象，文章标题为

sentences.en: Fatal Distraction.
sentences.zh: 《致命的疏忽》。

sentences.en: After looking into various cases and statistics involving children left in hot cars,
sentences.zh: 在调查了涉及将儿童遗忘在炎热车内的各种案例和统计数据后，

sentences.en: Jean concluded,
sentences.zh: 简得出结论：

sentences.en: What kind of person forgets a baby?
sentences.zh: 究竟什么样的人会把婴儿忘在车里？

sentences.en: The wealthy do, it turns out.
sentences.zh: 事实证明，有钱人会。

sentences.en: And the poor.
sentences.zh: 穷人也会。

sentences.en: And the middle class.
sentences.zh: 中产阶级也会。

sentences.en: Parents of all ages and ethnicities do.
sentences.zh: 各个年龄段和各种族背景的父母都会。

sentences.en: Mothers are just as likely to do it as fathers.
sentences.zh: 母亲犯下这种错的几率和父亲一样高。

sentences.en: It happens to the chronically absent-minded and to the fanatically organised, to the college-educated and to the marginally literate.
sentences.zh: 这会发生在一向心不在焉的人身上，也会发生在极度井井有条的人身上；会发生在受过大学教育的人身上，也会发生在识字不多的人身上。

sentences.en: Last year, it happened three times in one day.
sentences.zh: 去年，同一天内就发生了三次。

sentences.en: The worst day so far in the worst year so far, in a phenomenon that gives no sign of abating.
sentences.zh: 这是迄今为止最糟糕的一年中最糟糕的一天，而这种现象没有任何减弱的迹象。

sentences.en: It therefore caused public outrage when it was announced that Ross Harris was being charged not only with second-degree child cruelty, but with Cooper's murder.
sentences.zh: 因此，当宣布罗斯·哈里斯不仅被控二级虐待儿童罪，还被控谋杀库珀时，引发了公众的愤怒。

sentences.en: People who knew the Harris family, as well as total strangers, immediately came to Ross's defence.
sentences.zh: 认识哈里斯一家的熟人以及完全的陌生人，都立刻站出来为罗斯辩护。

sentences.en: Two petitions were launched urging authorities to release Ross and drop the charges.
sentences.zh: 当时发起了两项请愿活动，敦促当局释放罗斯并撤销指控。

sentences.en: Concerned citizens said Ross had suffered enough and should not be punished for an innocent lapse in memory.
sentences.zh: 关切的市民表示，罗斯已经承受够了，不应该因为一次无心的记忆失误而受到惩罚。

sentences.en: Other parents whose children had died as a result of forgotten baby syndrome also came out in support of Ross, with one of his friends writing on one of the petitions,
sentences.zh: 其他因遗忘婴儿综合征而失去孩子的父母也站出来支持罗斯，他的一位朋友在其中一份请愿书上写道：

sentences.en: Ross is an incredible friend.
sentences.zh: 罗斯是个不可多得的好朋友。

sentences.en: He's always the first to help when tragedy strikes others, so I am returning the favour.
sentences.zh: 当别人遭遇悲剧时，他总是第一个伸出援手，所以我现在是在回报他。

sentences.en: Another said,
sentences.zh: 另一位说：

sentences.en: I've known Ross for over ten years and he is a selfless man who loved people and loved his family more.
sentences.zh: 我认识罗斯十多年了，他是一个无私的人，深爱着大家，更深爱着他的家人。

sentences.en: But from the moment police arrived on the scene outside the Acres Mill Square shopping centre, they didn't feel like this was a typical hot car death.
sentences.zh: 但从警察赶到阿克雷斯米尔广场购物中心外的现场那一刻起，他们就觉得这并不是一起典型的热车儿童死亡案。

sentences.en: Straight off the bat was the unusual positioning of Cooper's car seat.
sentences.zh: 首先引起注意的是库珀安全座椅的异常摆放位置。

sentences.en: Unlike most hot car deaths, where the child was in a rear-facing seat either directly behind the driver's seat or passenger seat,
sentences.zh: 与大多数热车死亡案不同，在那些案件中，孩子坐在面向后方的座椅上，位置正对着驾驶座或副驾驶座的后面，

sentences.en: Cooper's rear-facing seat was in the middle.
sentences.zh: 而库珀面向后方的安全座椅却在中间。

sentences.en: This placed him just inches from the driver's seat, right near Ross's elbow.
sentences.zh: 这使得他距离驾驶座只有几英寸之遥，就在罗斯的手肘旁。

sentences.en: It was hard for the police to imagine that Ross could have looked to his right without seeing him there.
sentences.zh: 警察很难想象罗斯向右看时会看不到他在那里。

sentences.en: Furthermore, when crime scene examiners entered the car, they were hit with the distinct odour that they knew to be the smell of death.
sentences.zh: 此外，当犯罪现场勘查人员进入车内时，扑面而来的是一股他们熟知的死亡气味。

sentences.en: They could also smell Cooper's urine-soaked diaper.
sentences.zh: 他们还能闻到库珀那条浸满尿液的尿布的味道。

sentences.en: It seemed unimaginable that Ross could have driven the two miles from his work to Acres Mill Square without noticing the odour and investigating its source.
sentences.zh: 很难想象罗斯从工作地点开车两英里到阿克雷斯米尔广场时，竟然会闻不到这股气味并去查明来源。

sentences.en: Not only that, but Cooper's autopsy confirmed that he was 33 inches tall.
sentences.zh: 不仅如此，库珀的尸检证实他的身高有33英寸。

sentences.en: The height limit for his car seat was 30 inches and by Cooper's age, most parents had already opted to put their children in forward-facing seats.
sentences.zh: 他那个安全座椅的身高限制是30英寸，按照库珀这个年纪，大多数父母都已经选择让孩子坐面向前方的座椅了。

sentences.en: Then there was Ross's reaction at the scene.
sentences.zh: 还有罗斯在现场的反应。

sentences.en: Passers-by who had seen Ross pull Cooper from his car found it strange that he placed the child's body on the hot pavement and stopped attempting CPR
sentences.zh: 亲眼看到罗斯把库珀从车里抱出来的路人觉得很奇怪，他把孩子的尸体放在滚烫的人行道上，

sentences.en: after just a couple of compressions.
sentences.zh: 仅仅做了几下按压就停止了心肺复苏。

sentences.en: It seemed even stranger that he walked away from Cooper and immediately got on his cell phone while others stepped in to try and help his son.
sentences.zh: 更奇怪的是，当其他人介入试图帮助他的儿子时，他却从库珀身边走开，立刻打起了手机。

sentences.en: Curiously,
sentences.zh: 奇怪的是，

sentences.en: Ross didn't call emergency services but instead tried calling Cooper's daycare so that they could alert Leanna.
sentences.zh: 罗斯没有拨打紧急救援电话，而是试着给库珀的日托中心打电话，以便他们能通知莉安娜。

sentences.en: Witnesses and police thought his reaction looked staged.
sentences.zh: 目击者和警察都认为他的反应看起来像是演出来的。

sentences.en: One minute he was shrieking hysterically, the next he was completely calm.
sentences.zh: 他上一分钟还在歇斯底里地尖叫，下一分钟就完全平静了下来。

sentences.en: While he appeared to be crying, he didn't shed any actual tears.
sentences.zh: 虽然他看起来在哭，但却没有流下一滴眼泪。

sentences.en: One officer described Ross's behaviour as very random and very odd while another thought that his yelling seemed monotone and forced.
sentences.zh: 一名警官形容罗斯的行为非常随意且十分怪异，而另一名警官则认为他的叫喊声听起来单调而又勉强。

sentences.en: Things just got stranger once Ross was placed in the police car.
sentences.zh: 而当罗斯被带进警车后，事情变得更加诡异了。

sentences.en: Despite having found his son dead in a hot car just minutes earlier,
sentences.zh: 尽管几分钟前才刚在热车里发现死去的儿子，

sentences.en: Ross immediately started complaining about how hot it was even though the air conditioning was on.
sentences.zh: 罗斯却立刻开始抱怨天气有多热，尽管车里开着空调。

sentences.en: He also complained that the handcuffs were hurting him and asked for them to be released.
sentences.zh: 他还抱怨手铐弄疼了他，要求解开手铐。

sentences.en: At no point did he ask to see Cooper or mention him at all.
sentences.zh: 他自始至终都没有要求见库珀，也没有提及他半句。

sentences.en: Dashcam footage captured Ross as he alternated between sitting calmly and wailing, oh my god, what have I done?
sentences.zh: 行车记录仪拍下了罗斯在平静坐着和嚎啕大哭之间的切换过程：“哦，天哪，我都做了些什么？”

sentences.en: My boy, what have I done?
sentences.zh: “我的孩子，我都做了些什么？”

sentences.en: At one point, he looked directly into the camera.
sentences.zh: 有一刻，他直勾勾地盯着摄像头。

sentences.en: Then, on the drive to the police station,
sentences.zh: 接着，在开往警察局的路上，

sentences.en: Ross engaged in casual chit-chat with the officer who detained him.
sentences.zh: 罗斯和拘留他的警官闲聊了起来。

sentences.en: He asked her how long she had been in law enforcement and made comments about how the handcuffs their department used were different to the ones he had seen
sentences.zh: 他问对方当了多久警察，并评论说他们部门用的手铐和他以前在阿拉巴马州当警察时

sentences.en: while working for the police in Alabama.
sentences.zh: 见到的手铐不一样。

sentences.en: This casual conversation, coming from a man who had just lost a child under horrific circumstances, made the officer uncomfortable.
sentences.zh: 这种轻松的闲聊，出自一个在惨烈情况下刚刚失去孩子的父亲之口，让警官感到很不舒服。

sentences.en: This erratic behaviour continued once Ross was put into the interrogation room.
sentences.zh: 这种反复无常的行为在罗斯被关进审讯室后仍在继续。

sentences.en: During the 14-minute wait before the interviewing detectives arrived, video cameras captured Ross sitting calmly.
sentences.zh: 在等待审讯侦探到来的那14分钟里，视频摄像头拍下了罗斯平静坐着的画面。

sentences.en: Every now and then, his calm demeanour would give way to a brief moment of dry-eyed crying, wailing, or heavy breathing, interspersed with erratic yells of, oh god, my boy, why?
sentences.zh: 每隔一会儿，他平静的表情就会转瞬即逝，变成没有眼泪的痛哭、嚎啕或沉重的呼吸，其间夹杂着“哦，天哪，我的孩子，为什么？”的狂乱喊叫。

sentences.en: At one point, he started pacing around the room, rubbing his eyes and huffing.
sentences.zh: 有一会儿，他在房间里踱来踱去，揉着眼睛，大口喘着粗气。

sentences.en: One of the detectives who was watching Ross on the camera thought he looked like he was trying to make himself hyperventilate.
sentences.zh: 一名通过监控观察罗斯的侦探认为，他看起来像是在试图让自己过度换气。

sentences.en: When Leanna was taken in to see him,
sentences.zh: 当莉安娜被带进去看他时，

sentences.en: Ross started talking about how scared he was of going to prison.
sentences.zh: 罗斯开始诉说自己有多害怕坐牢。

sentences.en: All I can think about is that jail cell, he said, specifying he was particularly worried about the hard bed and the metal toilet.
sentences.zh: “我满脑子想的都是那间牢房，”他说，并具体提到他特别担心那张硬床和金属马桶。

sentences.en: He also asked what would happen if he lost his job.
sentences.zh: 他还问如果自己失去了工作会怎么样。

sentences.en: To the investigators, these seemed like strange concerns for a man who had just lost his son to a slow and painful death.
sentences.zh: 在调查人员看来，对于一个刚因缓慢而痛苦的死亡失去儿子的父亲来说，这些似乎是些奇怪的担忧。

sentences.en: Stranger still,
sentences.zh: 更奇怪的是，

sentences.en: Ross had told Leanna that when he pulled
sentences.zh: 罗斯曾对莉安娜说，当他把

sentences.en: Cooper from the vehicle, he, quote, dreaded how he would look.
sentences.zh: 库珀从车里抱出来时，他“引号，极其恐惧他当时的尊容”。

sentences.en: Not only did investigators find it concerning that Ross had used the past tense, but Ross told Leanna that Cooper's eyes had been closed and he looked at peace.
sentences.zh: 调查人员不仅对罗斯使用了过去时态感到担忧，而且罗斯还对莉安娜说库珀的眼睛是闭着的，看起来很安详。

sentences.en: First responders at the scene said that Cooper's eyes had actually been open.
sentences.zh: 现场的第一响应者却表示，库珀当时其实是睁着眼睛的。

sentences.en: When Ross was taken to a holding cell after being informed he was being arrested for murder, his cellmate also found his demeanour to be inconsistent with someone who had just lost
sentences.zh: 当罗斯在被告知因谋杀罪被捕而被带到候审室时，他的狱友也觉得他的表现与一个刚失去

sentences.en: a child.

sentences.zh: 当警方问及莉安娜的婚姻状况时，她说她和罗斯有时会感到经济压力很大。

sentences.zh: 对这对夫妇财务记录的搜查显示，他们有学生贷款、汽车贷款以及大约4000美元的信用卡债务。

sentences.en: Text messages between the two also indicated that Leanna was unhappy about some purchases

sentences.en: Rumours started circulating about the possibility that Ross and Leanna had conspired in Cooper's death for financial gain.

sentences.en: Although police made it clear that no charges were being filed against Leanna, social media went into overdrive with an article in the Atlanta Journal-Constitution reporting,

sentences.zh: 许多人在琢磨，莉安娜·哈里斯是不是还有不为人知的一面。”

sentences.zh: 另一个人写道：

sentences.zh: “我希望你和你好似嚼着反刍食物的丑陋母牛妻子在地狱里燃烧，因为你们谋杀了这个宝贝。”

sentences.zh: 另一个人写信给莉安娜：

sentences.zh: “我希望库珀的尖叫声一直纠缠着你，直到你最终崩溃并承认你做了什么。”

sentences.en: The public allegations took a massive toll on Leanna.
sentences.zh: 公众的指责给莉安娜带来了巨大的打击。

sentences.en: Not only was she still coming to terms with the loss of her son, she was humiliated to find out about Ross's infidelity.
sentences.zh: 她不仅还在承受失去儿子的悲痛，而且发现罗斯的不忠也让她感到无比羞辱。

sentences.en: Leanna claimed she knew nothing about her husband's online or real world affairs.
sentences.zh: 莉安娜坚称她对丈夫在网上或现实生活中的婚外情一无所知。

sentences.en: She was aware that Ross had struggled with a pornography addiction back in 2008 and she'd once found a message on his phone asking a woman for pictures of her breasts.
sentences.zh: 她知道罗斯早在2008年就曾与色情成瘾作过斗争，她曾经在他的手机上发现过一条信息，内容是向一个女人索要胸部照片。

sentences.en: The two had sought help for these issues together, speaking with their pastor and going to couples therapy for a while.

sentences.en: Then, in around December 2012,
sentences.zh: 然后，大约在2012年12月，

sentences.zh: 他们重新开始做心理治疗，直到一切感觉重回正轨。

sentences.en: As far as Leanna was concerned, at the time of Cooper's death,
sentences.zh: 就莉安娜而言，在库珀去世时，

sentences.zh: 罗斯已经把所有这些问题都控制住了。

sentences.en: She had no idea his behaviour had ever extended to full-blown infidelity and had she known, she would have sought a divorce.
sentences.zh: 她根本不知道他的行为竟然发展到了彻底出轨的地步，如果她早知道的话，她早就提出离婚了。

sentences.en: Leanna was also adamant that she had nothing to do with Cooper's death.
sentences.zh: 莉安娜还坚决表示，她与库珀的死没有任何关系。

sentences.en: She later explained to ABC's 2020 program that she could understand why people might have thought her seemingly emotionless behaviour was suspicious
sentences.zh: 她后来向美国广播公司（ABC）的《20/20》节目解释说，她能理解为什么人们会觉得她看似毫无感情的表现很可疑，

sentences.en: because she couldn't quite understand it herself.
sentences.zh: 因为她自己也无法完全理解。

sentences.zh: “一个人根本无从得知自己会有什么反应，”她解释道。

sentences.en: She hadn't felt any anger towards him at that moment because she knew it was an accident and her priority was to provide him with support.
sentences.zh: 她当时对罗斯没有任何愤怒，因为她知道这是一场意外，而她的当务之急是给他提供支持。

sentences.en: She only asked Ross if he said too much to the police because she knew his personality and he, quote, doesn't shut up.
sentences.zh: 她之所以问罗斯是不是对警察说得太多了，只是因为她了解他的性格，他“嘴碎，停不下来”。

sentences.en: All she could think was what could Ross have possibly said to make the police think that he had left Cooper in the car on purpose?
sentences.zh: 她脑子里想的全部都是：罗斯到底说了什么，才会让警察觉得他是故意把库珀留在车里的？

sentences.en: Investigators ultimately concluded there was absolutely no evidence to suggest Leanna was involved in Cooper's death in any way.
sentences.zh: 调查人员最终得出结论，绝对没有任何证据表明莉安娜以任何方式参与了库珀的死。

sentences.en: But that didn't stop the public and media scrutiny.
sentences.zh: 但这并没有阻止公众和媒体的审视。

sentences.en: Not only was Leanna struggling to deal with the grief of losing her son and now husband, she was unable to work and lost a long-running consulting job
sentences.zh: 莉安娜不仅要努力应对失去儿子以及如今失去丈夫的悲痛，她还无法工作，并由于媒体的反扑而

sentences.en: as a result of the media backlash.

sentences.zh: 她回到了阿拉巴马州，向罗斯提出了离婚，并恢复了婚前姓氏。

sentences.en: In a victim impact statement filed in August 2014,
sentences.zh: 在2014年8月提交的一份受害人影响陈述中，

sentences.zh: 莉安娜写道，她正生活在一种备受折磨的境遇中，只能依靠上帝赐予力量和支持。

sentences.en: Whatever issues transpired in our marriage is between God and us, for he will judge those moral sins, she wrote.
sentences.zh: “我们婚姻中发生的一切问题只有上帝和我们自己知道，因为他会审判这些道德上的罪孽，”她写道。

sentences.zh: “围绕在我家人身边的风暴让我们无法以正确的方式去哀悼，如果真有什么正确方式的话。”

sentences.en: Regardless of her feelings toward Ross,
sentences.zh: 无论她对罗斯有什么样的个人情感，

sentences.zh: 莉安娜都想明确一点。

sentences.zh: “罗斯是个好父亲，他全心全意地爱着库珀，”她在声明中写道。

sentences.zh: 社交媒体上充斥着要求处决他的呼声，公众甚至称应该让他像儿子一样在炎热的车里热死。

sentences.zh: 对于罗斯的支持者来说，在合理怀疑听证会上曝光的内幕让他们陷入了震惊状态。
